{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: internal test orders have revenue = 999999.99

print('Internal test order count:', internal_test_count)

# Convert revenue to numeric: remove commas and cast to float

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_no_internal = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != '999999.99')]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_no_internal['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print result
total_revenue"}
